note: The measured reach of the WP-3 case-model journey, recorded beside journey-backends.test.mjs. Probed against production, unauthenticated, redirect: manual. States only — a missing backend must show the EXACT unavailable capability and must never fake a completed fix. This file exists because capabilities/registry.json became a GENERATED VIEW (scripts/capability-render.mjs legacy) and cannot carry a hand-maintained record; the test and this data land together.
consequence_for_wp3_and_wp6: The journey is reachable as far as explain and no further: propose, approve, fix and retest have no runtime to call (ras, remediation and jobs answer 404 not_found), so WP-3's execute half remains a proposal for onward work and WP-6 records the same boundary on its approval side. The receipts register went from UNPUBLISHED (2026-09-05 probe, count 0) to PUBLISHED behind the owner gate (count 26), which moves the WP-6 receipt half from absent to gated.

findings.reason: 200 serving schema csoai.regulation-findings/0.1 with its honesty block, card-backed findings and as_of present — the read half of the journey has a runtime.

ras.reason: 404 not_found: no RAS loop runtime exists, so approve, fix and retest cannot execute against anything.

ras_status.reason: 404 not_found: the RAS status surface does not exist either, consistent with ras itself being unavailable.

remediation.reason: 404 not_found: no remediation runtime exists, so a fix step has nothing to call.

jobs.reason: 404 not_found: no job runtime exists, so a retest cannot be scheduled.

receipts.reason: 200 with status PUBLISHED and count 26 (2026-11-02): the receipts register went from UNPUBLISHED (2026-09-05 probe, count 0) to published and metered behind the owner gate, so the WP-6 receipt half now records a live, gated surface.

ras_metered_probes.reason: 402 on /api/ras/mcp-probe, /api/ras/x402-check and /api/ras/supply (2026-11-02): the ras read-side probe routes exist and are priced behind the x402 door — distinct from the ras execute loop itself, which still 404s at /api/ras.

not_a_claim: A 200 from a read endpoint is a measurement of that endpoint, not a statement that the journey works end to end. The execute half has no runtime and no surface may imply otherwise.
